notes: CONFIRMED is stored only where an official page retrieved on 2026-10-14 states the date, and the record has source_url plus source_checked_at. The public badge is Official Website Checked.

CWIEME Berlin 2027 is 27–29 April 2027 at Messe Berlin. Source: https://berlin.cwiemeevents.com/
Enlit Africa 2027 is 11–13 May 2027 at CTICC Cape Town. Source: https://www.enlit-africa.com/
IEEE PES General Meeting 2027 is 25–29 July 2027 at Hilton San Francisco Union Square. Source: https://pes-gm.org/
Saudi Elenex 2026 is 16–19 November 2026 at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Center. Source: the organiser brochure. The organiser homepage date of 2–5 November 2026 is not stored.
Middle East Energy 2028 start, end and venue are null and date_status is TBA. The homepage does not publish 2028 after the May move.

Intersolar & ees Middle East 2027 is sourced from https://www.intersolar.ae/, which prints Exhibition & Conference: May 11–13, 2027, Dubai Exhibition Center (DEC). The same page still mentions Dubai World Trade Centre. The dated header is the venue used. The Middle East Energy homepage is not the source of this row.
WETEX 2026 is not stamped CONFIRMED. wetex.ae returned HTTP 403 to this checker, so date_status stays null and the UAE market page does not list it as confirmed.
Saudi Elenex 2023 post-show figures are not copied onto the 2026 edition. The 2026 page figures (160+ exhibitors, 8000+ sqm, 14+ countries) stay on the 2026 edition.
Enlit Africa “2026 in numbers” stay on the 2026 edition only.

CWIEME Berlin 2026 key exhibitors are the three names under Who exhibited in 2026 (Hitachi Energy Sweden AB Components, Maschinenfabrik Reinhausen, DuPont). The 2026 dates are not restated on the 2027 page, so that edition is not CONFIRMED.
PES General Meeting 2028 (23–27 July 2028, Washington, D.C., Marriott Marquis) is added because pes-gm.org publishes it on the same page used to correct 2027.
Unknown fields stay null and render as Not yet published by organiser. Null counts below are expected.

IEEE PES Transformers Committee pages presented an expired TLS certificate. They were read on 14 Oct 2026 after that warning. Fall 2026 names the Omni Fort Lauderdale Hotel. The meetings index lists 2026 only, so 2027 stays TBA.
World Power Industry Expo 2026 and UzEnergyExpo 2026 had listing-site URLs (eventseye, 10times). Those URLs are not published as official sites.
